product.adding_to_cart: Adding your configured item to the cart…
product.cart_error: We could not add this configured item to your cart. Please try again.
product.customize_help: Complete the required details before adding this item to your cart.
product.configuration_error: This product is temporarily unavailable while its customization settings are being checked.

allocation.title: Options by item
allocation.help: Choose how many customizable items use each option. Add another option only when you want to split the total.

personalization.help: Choose no personalization, use the same personalization for every item, or split personalization across the items in this order.

custom_order.title: Request a custom order
custom_order.intro: Build your request step by step. JILL automatically uses each product’s current Shopify variations, Product Options, personalization rules and required details.

customer.title: Your details
customer.help: Tell us how to reach you about this request.
customer.name: Name

products.title: Choose your products
products.help: Select one or more products. New catalog products and collections automatically appear here without changing the form.

configuration.title: Customize your products
configuration.help: Set quantity, Shopify variations, Product Options, personalization and references required by each selected product.

planning.title: Event and fulfillment
planning.help: Tell us when you need the order and whether you’ll pick it up or have it shipped.
planning.event_date_help: For shipping requests, the earliest selectable event date is 12 business days from today. This helps us plan and does not guarantee delivery by that date.

final.title: Final details
final.help: Confirm the request terms before reviewing everything together.
final.acknowledgment: I understand this is a request, not a confirmed order. Pricing, availability and timing are confirmed by JILL after review.
final.marketing: Yes — send me JILL party ideas, new designs and occasional offers.

variants.title: Variations
variants.help: Split the total product quantity across the Shopify variations you need. Each variation can be used once.
variants.incomplete: Assign the full product quantity across variations before continuing.

review.title: Review your custom order request
review.help: Check every detail below before sending the request to JILL.
review.confirm: I reviewed the information above and it is accurate.

success.title: Your request has been submitted
success.body: Thank you for choosing JILL. We received your custom order request and will contact you using your preferred contact method with pricing, availability and next steps.
